title: (RHBA-2017:1237) Update to Fuse Integration Services 2.0 Images
portal_summary:

portal_synopsis: Update to Fuse Integration Services 2.0 Images
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.4|x86_64

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

FIS 2.0
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en/red-hat-jboss-middleware-for-openshift/3/single/red-hat-jboss-fuse-integration-services-20-for-openshift/
portal_description:
Red Hat JBoss Fuse Integration Services provides a set of tools and
containerized xPaaS images that enable development, deployment, and management of integration microservices within OpenShift.

OpenJDK 1.7 packages are not present in this version of the Fuse Integration Services (FIS) 2.0 images. Previous versions of the FIS 2.0 images included the OpenJDK 1.7 packages, but this was an unintended side effect of the rh-maven33 package, which depended on OpenJDK 1.7. The new version of rh-maven33 has been fixed, so that it runs on OpenJDK 1.8, which is the default JDK version for the FIS 2.0 images. The new FIS images include only the OpenJDK 1.8 packages.
